black-pearls.description:
Ships within 2 business days, with tracking.

A scented candle in clear hand-blown glass with black details, for the dining table, the mantel or a console.

Black Pearls takes its name from the precious pearls its glass recalls; lit, the flame glows through the black inlays. Made in Europe by Baobab Collection: the glass is hand-blown in Poland, the wax poured by hand, the perfume composed in Grasse.

  • Fragrance: ginger and black rose: strong and subtle at once

  • Sizes: MAX 10 (Classique): 10 cm high (3.9 in), 500 g of wax, up to 50 hours. MAX 16 (Signature): 16 cm high (6.3 in), 1.1 kg of wax, up to 100 hours. MAX 24 (Grande): 24 cm high (9.4 in), 3 kg of wax, up to 340 hours. Figures are the maison's.

  • Care: let the whole surface melt on every burn, then burn no more than one hour longer; keep the melted layer under 1 cm and stop with 1 cm of wax left in the glass. Never leave a lit candle unattended.

apotheca-scented-candles.description:
Ships within 2 business days, with tracking.

A scented candle in a dark amber apothecary jar, made by hand in Grasse, for a bedside, the bath or a bookshelf.

Apotheca Paris makes its home scents in Grasse, the city of the great perfumers. The wax is poured in the tradition of French candle makers and each cotton wick is set by hand. The scents are by Rodolphe Borgniet, drawn from the apothecary counter his family kept, its secrets under lock and key.

  • Size: 9 cm across, 9.5 cm high (3.5 x 3.75 in)

  • Candle: 240 g (8.5 oz) of natural, vegetable-based scented wax, about 50 hours of burning

  • Scents: Nigrum Tulipa: black tulip and amber; Purpura: fresh fig leaf and warm sandalwood; Vipera: warm, spicy-sweet musk with smoky guaiac wood; Vitae: sweet orange blossom and mandarin; Insidiae: bitter citrus and fresh bergamot.

  • Care: trim the wick before lighting, keep the flame away from drafts, and never leave a lit candle unattended.
apotheca-scented-candles.seo_title: Apotheca Scented Candle, Made in Grasse
apotheca-scented-candles.seo_description: Apotheca candle poured by hand in Grasse, France, in an amber apothecary jar: 240 g, about 50 hours, five scents. Ships across Canada and the US.
